# Vibe Rescue

> Vibe Rescue is a free, MIT-licensed toolkit that turns an unfamiliar or AI-generated ("vibe-coded") Git repository into a source-linked team handoff (HTML and Markdown, English and Vietnamese): what the code does, how its parts connect, functional blocks mapped to real functions, and what must be verified. The first pass runs offline with no AI. It also finds concrete problems with free static-analysis tools (dead code, copy-paste, over-complex functions, import cycles, unused dependencies, security mistakes, leaked secrets) and, only after a human approves, prepares small reversible fixes. Maps cover Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust, Go, Java, PHP and C# at different levels of detail; the generic handoff connects Python functions only. Version 0.8.0-preview. The optional AI steps run through Claude Code, Codex, or any OpenAI-style model server through a built-in adapter, which has been tested with a scripted fake server and one toy project with one hosted model, not yet with Gemma or Qwen on a real server. Unattended repair of production code is not approved. Maps are static: they show who can call whom, not run-time behavior. Quick start (no pip install; the first ./vr prepares its own Python environment): git clone https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue.git, cd vibe_rescue, ./vr doctor, ./vr explore PROJECT, ./vr check PROJECT; optional AI steps: ./vr ai, ./vr report PROJECT, ./vr fix PROJECT --test "CMD". Everything is written to PROJECT/VIBE_RESCUE/ (start with START_HERE.md). There is no Python wheel.

Author and maintainer: Nguyễn Anh Nguyên (Nguyen Anh Nguyen).
Keywords: vibe coding rescue, open source code audit toolkit, legacy code, AI-generated code review, technical debt, call graph, codebase map.

## Start here
- [Document index](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/docs/README.md): every document with its language and purpose
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/AGENTS.md): map of the repository for agents, commands, what not to read
- [Full guide](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/docs/GUIDE.md): the longer explanations (Vietnamese: GUIDE.vi.md)
- [Full text for LLMs](https://thusinh1969.github.io/vibe_rescue/llms-full.txt): README, v0.8 preview contract and security notes in one file
- [v0.8-preview capability contract](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/docs/V0.8_PREVIEW.md): what another team can run today (Vietnamese: V0.8_PREVIEW.vi.md)
- [Example handoff](https://thusinh1969.github.io/vibe_rescue/examples/support_ticket/VIBE_RESCUE/handoff.html): a complete generated team handoff for a synthetic project

## How it works
- [Owner pact](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/docs/OWNER_PACT.md): nothing changes without human approval, backup and revert (Vietnamese)
- [Voyage protocol](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/docs/VOYAGE.md): map, prove, review, plan, repair, lock (Vietnamese)
- [Pipeline](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/docs/PIPELINE.md): entry and exit criteria of each phase (Vietnamese)
- [Logic atlas](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/docs/LOGIC_ATLAS.md): what the maps can and cannot show (Vietnamese)
- [Output protocol](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/docs/OUTPUT_PROTOCOL.md): the plain-language report for the team (Vietnamese)

## Safety and limits
- [Security](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/SECURITY.md): a Git worktree is not a sandbox; redaction is best effort
- [Small-model evaluation](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/docs/SMALL_MODEL_EVAL.md): sample-task test for open and cheap models, with results and limits (Vietnamese)

## Optional
- [Tool versions](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/tools/manifest.toml): the pinned checking tools
- [Role config](https://github.com/thusinh1969/vibe_rescue/blob/master/config.toml): which AI program plays which role
